items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Was it Ben Varders, the drummer with the Black and Tan? Did you ever hear him?

ctx.x: He played with that piano player, Sonny Clay, huh, too, out there. Sonny Clay? You know him? No, I don't know. He was a drummer and a piano player. No, Sonny Clay. I guess he came late on that, but Cuoco recorded on Coronet with him. Oh, I see.

Well, I think I just remember the drummer there. Was it Ben Varders, the drummer with the Black and Tan? Did you ever hear him? Who? Varders. Varder. I think it was Ben Varders. What kind of music was out there in the local bands in California? Was it anything like the style of the Marlene's band? No, it wasn't. That's why we taken so. That's what I wondered.
That's why we taken. See, now the Black and Tan band was the best band there, you know, see. Trying to play like us, you know. But after we went there, then.
